\cvsection{About Me}

Electronics engineering student focused on embedded systems and low-level software development. Hands-on experience with bare-metal STM32/ARM firmware, ESP32, FPGA/VHDL digital design, and Docker-based infrastructure. Experienced across the full stack, from register-level peripheral drivers to Linux and Python automation tooling.

\cvsection{Embedded \& Software Projects}

\entrytitle{SCADA System for Industrial PLC}
\small
Designed and implemented a low-cost SCADA system integrating a Linux-based industrial PLC with Node-RED for real-time HMI monitoring and secure remote access via a WireGuard-based mesh VPN.
\vspace{0.4em}

\entrytitle{RISC-V Processor Core}
\small
Designed and implemented a custom 32-bit RISC-V processor core in VHDL for FPGA logic synthesis and functional hardware execution.
\vspace{0.4em}

\entrytitle{IEEE-754 Floating-Point Calculator}
\small
Developed a 32-bit floating-point arithmetic unit in VHDL and ARM Assembly featuring UART-based dynamic I/O communication.
\vspace{0.4em}

\entrytitle{STM32 Bare-Metal Drivers}
\small
Wrote register-level SPI drivers for ILI9341 and ST7735R TFT displays with XPT2046 resistive touch controller integration directly from datasheets.
\vspace{0.4em}

\entrytitle{Custom PCB \& Power Hardware Design}
\small
Designed minimum-system MCU development boards in KiCad and developed power electronics topologies with custom board layouts.
\vspace{0.4em}

\entrytitle{FPV Flight Controller Board Debugging}
\small
Assembled an FPV quadcopter running Betaflight on an STM32F103 flight controller; resolved hardware issues on non-standard clone boards.
\vspace{0.4em}

\entrytitle{Self-Hosted Homelab Infrastructure}
\small
Architected and managed a self-hosted Linux NAS containerizing microservices like Home Assistant, local storage, and media streaming via Docker.
\vspace{0.4em}

\entrytitle{Workflow Automation \& DevTools}
\small
Built Python and Playwright web scrapers/automation tools utilizing Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) for event management systems.
\vspace{0.4em}
